label: Code repo
doc: One row per repository Code Query has been pointed at. This is the
failing pull shows up here rather than in a dashboard nobody owns, so it
is an inbox item like anything else that needs a human.
last_indexed_sha is the cursor the git connector's `pull` resumes from —
not a version of this object, a pointer into the repo's own history.

provider.description: Which connector produced this repo. "local" is a clone on disk read by commonindex/workers/connectors/localgit.py — a real source, not a fixture: Zoekt indexes a git directory natively, and a self-hosted forge is reachable by clone long before anyone writes an API connector for it.

last_indexed_sha.description: The pull cursor. Null before the first successful pull.

acl_crawled_at.description: N1 rule 2 — crawled on its own, faster-than-content cadence, tracked separately from last_indexed_at so staleness on either dimension is visible on its own.
